values: Vanishing of the cellularization map for non-p-nilpotent component groups — Alec Kriebel, v1.0.0, 2026-10-17. Problem 30006658 / OWR-14299915-021: affirmative answer to Greenlees Question 2.2, OWR 9/2026 p.594. For every compact Lie group with non-p-nilpotent component group and every characteristic-p field, the completed loop-chain cellularization map is zero on all homotopy groups.
